songs.title: petrichor in boulder
songs.lyrics:
I guess I want this to be a bit of a retrospective on the last... over a month? I guess
I'm not sure how long this will go, but I'll just, I'll just talk, cause why not
Can i close this? Yeah, i can, great. Okay, so

This was the most magical moment
This was one of the most beautiful moments of the whole trip
Because, it was starting to rain a little
And you could smell the petrichor
And it was just this perfect weather, you know?
Like that weather where you just feel alive
You just feel, you feel alive for some reason
Even though it's like, cloudy
It's like, you feel, it's like, youthful
It's like, rejuvenating
And we both felt that and we felt so inspired
And I remember we talked, we looked at some, sea
Like, uh, houses by the river in boulder
And we talked about how nice it would be to live there
And that made me really happy

Yeah, and we woke up the next day, we said goodbye
We walked to the station in Boulder
And, for the time being, we parted
We uh, I didn't cry, at that point
I don't think she did either
Paid 10 bucks for the bus to the airport
And that was that
That was the trip
